options.silkswitch.title: Silk Switch Settings
option.silkswitch.silk_touch.tooltip: Press the swap key to switch the tool in your hand between Fortune and Silk Touch.
option.silkswitch.free_fortune.tooltip:
Lets tools that have only ever had Silk Touch switch to Fortune.

When off, a tool only switches back to the Fortune level it had before.
option.silkswitch.free_fortune_level.too: The Fortune level a Silk-only tool gets the first time it switches.
